provenance.note: one synthetic surface per constructed rule; every change is a data change, and no resolver code differs between the before and after of a rule

rules.change: the surface renames the service the telemetry capability binds to (sessionTelemetry -> telemetryBackend), member emit kept
rules.before: the shipped section binds the old name, so the capability is refused: a stale table must fail loud rather than resolve something that is not there
rules.after: one data row rebinds telemetry.emit to telemetryBackend.emit and declares a service-rename translation, so the capability resolves and reports as translate

rules.change: the surface gives settings a member named writableFields, which matches the refusal witness pattern volatile|writable
rules.after: the refusal is reported as outdated (stale), and a strict load refuses to start on a stale premise instead of passing it over

rules.change: the surface deletes tools.get, the member the tools.lookup role binds to
rules.after: the capability is refused before apply, capability() throws naming the missing member, has() is false, and nothing half-built is handed over
